pr_title: Additional Validation for PauseThresholdWriter and ResumeThresholdWriter
pr_body:
Fix #75166

Add in additional checks to ensure certain edge cases identified in the issue are handled appropriately to prevent programs from hanging indefinitely.
pr_comments: I've also submitted a PR so the API docs include info about the `PauseWriteThreshold` of zero being unlimited on the property too. https://github.com/dotnet/dotnet-api-docs/pull/8693
